summary: A collection window still waiting for its first snapshot reads as soon as its view publishes

replay.detail: Collection refresh scheduling only; claim admission and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database or persistent state changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; no coordinated member upgrade is required.

compatibility.detail: Frames and their order are unchanged. A window that subscribed while its view was not ready, and got a retryable resync, now reads when the roster or published view publishes rather than at the next paced reread, so its first snapshot no longer waits up to 1.5 s more. Held windows remain paced.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or interruption beyond a normal daemon restart.

manual.detail: No operator action or client configuration change is needed.

recovery.detail: No persistent changes or new binary swap-back restrictions.
